summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py and added tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, reference as receiver). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()), using node-type-aware equality; _RDFNamespace inherits it. Container properties like rdf:_1 are not stored and return False. The IPython key-completion hook on ClosedNamespace now returns dir(self.uri). No imports added; term resolution and NamespaceManager unchanged. Tests added: prefix positive/negative/self/containment cases, SH membership, RDFS closed positive/negative plus Literal and str negatives, and RDF closed positive plus rdf:_1 negative. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. No commit was made.
